changelog: v1.0.1: WebUI bridge fix — commands now use absolute moduleDir paths from getModuleInfo(), so the WebUI works on Shizuku-Next (whose bridge exec has no default working directory and refuses the cwd option) as well as Shevery; added explicit 'switch to Full access' hint when the bridge is gated. v1.0.0: initial release — GMS stopped-state detection & unstop (Android 13+), triple GCM heartbeat, per-boot one-shot auto recovery, target manager, vivo deep links, offline WebUI. Requires Full access + Allow background actions, shell uid 2000 only.
